notes: Lifetimes are the Cooper, Gibson, Lawler (1997) LIF values as reprinted in Table 1 of Sobeck et al. 2007 (arXiv version read; 65 of the 131 levels) - method "compilation" because the original was not opened. Transition probabilities are from the machine-readable Table 3 of Sobeck et al. at CDS, restricted to lines the site draws plus all lines from z7P, y7P and z5P; NIST ASD already contains A values of comparable origin for most of them. rme_J_ea0 is derived from A with the SCHEMA convention. 53Cr has negative A in 7S3, 7P4, 5D4, 5D3 (inverted hyperfine structure; F = 9/2 is the lowest ground-state level). Isotope-shift keys are written 53-52 with the sign as printed in the source; where the source did not state its sign convention this is said in the note.
